mapper.insert: insert into fitian.Member (uid, name, nickname, boxName, email, rank, gender, boxCode, useYN, joinDate) value (#{uid},#{name},#{nickname},#{boxName},#{email},#{rank},#{gender},#{boxCode}, "Y", #{joinDate})
mapper.update:
update fitian.Member SET
name=#{name},
nickname=#{nickname},
boxName=#{boxName},
email=#{email},
rank=#{rank},
boxCode=#{boxCode},
gender=#{gender},
useYN="Y", uid=#{uid} where uid = #{uid}
